name: hud-card
description: The command card: icons on a 4 x 3 grid with the hotkey in the top left corner and a caption under each icon. Three tanks, a constructor and two trucks stand together in Big Arena. card-orders: the tanks selected, row 1 Fight F, Patrol P, Guard V, Stop X, row 2 Patrol base B, Retreat Z, Fire stance L, Hold position K, row 3 empty. card-return-fire: the same tanks on return fire, the fire stance slot shows the incoming arrow over the outgoing shell and says Return fire. card-hold-fire: the tanks on hold fire and holding position, the fire stance slot shows the shell in a no-entry ring and says Hold fire, the hold position slot is lit and says Holding. card-build: the constructor selected, 18 of its 20 structures (the harness player has no faction) in 6 columns from the top left, nothing paged. card-fleet: the trucks selected (they drive off to work, so every own truck is selected, not the ones near the spawn), the order rows on rows 1 and 2 and the recycle button and the fleet status on row 3. card-cancel-build: the constructor puts down a pylon through the build menu's placement and the site is selected; its card has only the stop slot, showing the crate with an X and Cancel build, with no key (the stop key skips structures). The checks read the card itself: captions, the lit toggle, the columns, the fleet row and the Cancel build slot. Run it at a true 1920x1080 (80 px slots) and a true 1280x720 (64 px slots).

checks.name: Patrol base is row 2, column 1 (the fifth slot)
the stances read Fire at will and Hold position, not lit
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('Command_fire_stance', true, false).get_node('Caption').text == 'Fire at will' and api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).get_node('Caption').text == 'Hold position' and not api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).button_pressed

checks.name: Hold position fits its slot
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).get_node('Caption').get_theme_font('font').get_string_size(api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).get_node('Caption').text, 0, -1, api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).get_node('Caption').get_theme_font_size('font_size')).x <= api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).get_node('Caption').size.x

checks.name: the fire stance slot says Return fire
Hold fire, and hold position lit and saying Holding
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('Command_fire_stance', true, false).get_node('Caption').text == 'Hold fire' and api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).button_pressed and api.match_node.find_child('Command_hold_position', true, false).get_node('Caption').text == 'Holding'

checks.name: the build menu is 6 columns with 18 slots
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('WorkerMenu', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('WorkerMenu', true, false).columns == 6 and api.match_node.find_child('WorkerMenu', true, false).get_child_count() == 18

checks.name: the fleet buttons sit on row 3, under the order rows
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('FleetMenu', true, false).is_visible_in_tree() and api.match_node.find_child('FleetMenu', true, false)._recycle_button.get_global_rect().position.y >= api.match_node.find_child('Command_patrol_base', true, false).get_global_rect().end.y

checks.name: one unit is selected: the pylon site
the pylon is still a construction site
the stop slot says Cancel build and shows no key
checks.code: api.match_node.find_child('CancelActionButton', true, false).get_node('Caption').text == 'Cancel build' and api.match_node.find_child('CancelActionButton', true, false).get_node('Hotkey').text == '' and api.match_node.find_child('CancelActionButton', true, false).tooltip_text == 'Cancel build'
